mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate directly raises discount rates for equity valuation, compressing price-to-earnings multiples and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days through reduced corporate revenue visibility.
failure_condition: Joint signal of declining HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in >45% of cases (SPX 20-day returns positive >45% of instances), or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation above 6.0% (CPIAUCSL) forces the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive policy, suppressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 6.0%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1400 thousand units signal a housing market contraction that reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when HOUST < 1400, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strong job growth (PAYEMS rising) and declining unemployment (UNRATE falling) signal a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to predict positive returns in >45% of cases (SPX 20-day returns negative >45% of instances), or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 2.0%) indicates robust economic expansion that elevates corporate earnings expectations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.
